provenance.input: Chrome DevTools accessibility actions and raw CDP pointer events

traces.name: open trailing pane
traces.action: Click the Section Config rail tab.

traces.name: resize leading pane
traces.action: Drag the 10 px leading-pane resize target from x=331 to x=397 through eight held pointer moves, then release.
traces.ownership: The pane width changed; the underlying canvas did not receive the pointer gesture.

traces.name: full width and restore
traces.action: Click the leading pane Full width button twice.

traces.name: close leading pane
traces.action: Click the selected Overview rail tab.

traces.name: full-width viewport normalization
traces.action: Resize the browser to a 1492 px page viewport while the trailing pane remains full width.

referenceKeyboardBoundary.nativeTabActivation: The rail controls are native buttons and activate with Enter or Space.
referenceKeyboardBoundary.packageAuthority: The milestone contract supplies the new roving tablist and Arrow/Home/End behavior.
